lockFileMaintenance.description: Weekly `nix flake update`. CI builds x86_64 and evaluates aarch64; a green check auto-merges and the Publisher does the real aarch64 build before anything ships (decision Q15).

customManagers.description: Service flake inputs pinned by tag (github:grmhay/<repo>/vX.Y.Z). The nix manager only tracks their locked rev as git-refs, never the tag, so this is what proposes a tag bump. Its PRs bump flake.nix only, not flake.lock: before merging one, run `nix flake update <input>` on the PR's branch and push the new flake.lock to the PR, or master's lock still pins the old tag's rev.

packageRules.description: Lockfile maintenance (nixpkgs) auto-merges on green CI

Service flake inputs (github:grmhay/*) always get a human, whichever manager proposes the update: the tag bumps from the regex manager (packageName grmhay/<repo>) and any digest update from the nix manager (packageName https://github.com/grmhay/<repo>)

The nix manager's commit (git-refs) lookups of the service inputs need git access the Mend job does not have, and the regex manager's tag bumps already cover them: turn these off rather than fail every run.

hostRules.description: Tag lookups (github-tags) use the read-only fine-grained PAT stored as the Mend org secret GH_RO_PAT: the Mend job token only reaches this repository, so it cannot see the private grmhay/* service repos. hostType github-tags keeps the app token for PRs, branches and issues. The PAT is read-only Contents on vm-service, packer-service, dhcp-service and dns-service (#25).
